name: @papercusp/eval-battery
description: The one eval-battery engine: a bounded variant×case×repeat battery loop with a swappable `Subject` port (run → collect/distill → judge → score, never-abort + rate-pause discipline) plus the frozen LLM-judge + scoring + rate-pause cores it owns. The gym is the `HarnessSubject` (a component eval), the Apiary/gen-0 is the `InstanceSubject` (a whole-instance eval) — one engine, two subjects (self-improvement-stack-reconciliation-2026-06-09 D-001). Pure, dependency-injected core; the only runtime dep is the rate-limit-error classifier.
